libs.desc: The party members and summons (Donald, Riku, Simba, Peter Pan, Genie, Stitch, Chicken Little and others), their behaviour, plus model drawing, animation and matrix maths. Source directory naka/, named after its programmer.

libs.desc: Minigames, among them the 100 Acre Wood ones (honey, the storm, jumping), with their players, objects and paths. Source directory taito/, named after its programmer.
The world map: landing on worlds, cameras, the Gummi Ship on the map, warps, menus. Source directory worldmap/, named after its programmer.
The cutscene (event) system: cameras, motion, sound, messages, layout. Also the Atlantica musical rhythm game. Source directory sasa/, named after its programmer.

files.e: saveram = save data; gumibattle = Gummi Ship battle

libs.desc: Visual effects: the particle system, screen shake, effect playback. Source directory rikeda/, named after its programmer.

The smaller source directories together: common (game modes), ishi (2D sprites and screen layouts), libyw (scroll bar), menu (menu widgets), ohori (sound), ovl_gumibattle, ovl_gumimenu, ovl_shop, riCommon (particle parts), sugi (assorted actions (skateboard and others)).
Code the file map could not place in an original source file yet: no anchor from the E3 debug build nearby. Grouped into provisional files by address.
